title: Warehouse Pick Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: Set the warehouse pick inspection scope, test readiness and requirement-level evidence, contain deficiencies, authorize status, and preserve qualified closeout.
description: An original, fillable warehouse pick inspection checklist form for controlling warehouse pick wave, order, carton, and lot allocation through inspection checklist identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use when a warehouse wave coordinator or qualified inspector must evaluate warehouse pick wave, order, carton, and lot allocation against the pick ticket, warehouse task, item master, and allocation record and provide a traceable basis for release, restriction, hold, correction, or rejection.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick inspection checklist identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

fields.label: Wave, pick ticket, and order number
SKU, lot, serial, carton, tote, or license-plate ID

blocks.label: Responsible parties and route points

fields.label: Zone, aisle, bin, or reserve location
Pack station, staging lane, dock, or production point

blocks.guidance: Preserve linkage to the pick ticket, warehouse task, item master, and allocation record.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Define the exact population and review basis so inspection conclusions remain bounded.

fields.label: Warehouse Pick Wave, Order, Carton, And Lot Allocation
Pick Ticket, Warehouse Task, Item Master, And Allocation Record

blocks.label: Warehouse Pick readiness verification
items: Wave, order priority, carrier cutoff, and staging destination are released
SKU, description, unit of measure, lot, serial, and expiry rules are available
Source bins and replenishment dependencies are assigned
Picker equipment, scan device, containers, and labels are ready
FIFO, FEFO, lot allocation, serial capture, and substitution rules are explicit
Fragile, hazardous, food, temperature, and security controls are routed
Short pick, damaged stock, blocked location, and count variance paths are defined
Pack, stage, and shipping handoffs require quantity and identity reconciliation
blocks.guidance: A failed readiness item must be resolved, excluded with rationale, or carried into the exception section.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick requirement-level inspection results
sections.guidance: Record actual observations against explicit criteria and identify the evidence for each result.

blocks.label: Warehouse Pick detailed inspection points
items: Wave, order, pick ticket, and destination identify the same work
SKU, description, unit of measure, and requested quantity agree
Source bin and scanned item identity match the released allocation
Lot, serial, expiry, revision, or status meets the selection rule
Picked quantity and pack quantity reconcile without unexplained remainder
Item and packaging show no damage, contamination, or improper exposure
Carton, tote, label, and staging lane identify the correct destination
Substitution or split allocation has explicit authorization
Short pick and replenishment attempts are time-stamped and owned
Unresolved identity, status, count, or condition issue remains on hold
blocks.guidance: Checkboxes indicate that the point was examined; the result table carries findings and evidence.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick measurements and evidence package
sections.guidance: Preserve readings, instruments, identity, and evidence needed to reproduce the inspection decision.

blocks.label: Measurement, count, or verification log
blocks.guidance: Use the method applicable to Required, picked, packed, and staged quantity and Item, lot, packaging, and label condition.

blocks.label: Available inspection evidence
items: Released pick ticket or warehouse task
Source-bin and item scan
Lot, serial, expiry, or revision capture
Short-pick and replenishment record
Pack verification and carton label
Staging lane or license-plate scan
Exception photograph or hold tag
Shipping or production handoff confirmation

blocks.label: Inspection observations, sampling limitations, and evidence interpretation

fields.label: Inspection observations, sampling limitations, and evidence interpretation

sections.title: Warehouse Pick exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Warehouse Pick exception indicators
items: Source bin empty or blocked
SKU or description does not match the released task
Lot, serial, expiry, revision, or inventory status is ineligible
Requested unit of measure differs from available pack
Picked quantity is short, over, or duplicated
Item or packaging is damaged, contaminated, or exposed
Substitution requested without authorization
Carton label or staging destination is incorrect
Replenishment or carrier cutoff cannot be met
System scan and physical identity cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick inspection status and release decision
sections.guidance: Do not turn a checklist score into release when a critical exception or evidence gap remains.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick inspection checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: Use this warehouse pick inspection checklist with the applicable customer commitment, carrier terms, site policy, and retention requirements. Do not infer acceptance or release from a signature alone; unresolved identity, count, condition, custody, or proof issues require an owner, escalation, and documented disposition.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by warehouse inventory control lead

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
